name: Singapore Telecommunications Limited
summary: Singapore Telecommunications Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides telecommunication services in Singapore, Australia, and internationally. It operates through Optus, Singtel Singapore, NCS, and Digital InfraCo segments. The company provides mobile, equipment sales, fixed voice and data, satellite, ICT and managed services; pay television, content and digital services, and ICT services and sells equipments; and technology services to clients through its Gov+, Enterprise, and Telco+ groups.
